name: Governor's Summer Job Hunt
org: Colorado Department of Labor and Employment, with local Workforce Centers
what_you_do: A free statewide service that lists summer job openings for young people and helps with job readiness. You register at a Workforce Center.
who_can_apply: Young people ages 14 to 24 per the Denver city page. No income rules. You must show proof of age and U.S. citizenship.
pay_detail: The service is free. The jobs it lists set their own pay.
deadline_text: Not stated. Register at any Workforce Center.
how_to_apply: Visit any Workforce Center in Colorado to register. Bring proof of age and U.S. citizenship.
notes: The Denver page and the Jefferson County workforce page both say ages 14 to 24. The state page (cdle.colorado.gov/jobs-training/youth/gsjh) would not load. If you are 14 or 15, call your local Workforce Center to check the age rule.
